notes.title: Hooray! King Island 2 is Here!
notes.notes:
We’re beyond happy to announce that King Island 2 is now live on Steam! This game was a labor of love for our team when we first developed it years ago, and we can't wait for you to dive back into it.

King Island 2 is a retro-Flash RPG that takes you on a wild adventure through the world of King's Island. Master the arcane arts, customize your character, and uncover the secrets of Kaptivo's transformation into an Arcane Warrior. 

Join us in celebrating the launch of our weird and wonderful King Island 2! Get your copy now and start your journey today.

To join the conversation and share your thoughts on the game with us, why not follow us on Twitter, Facebook or right here, in our Steam Community?

Thank you for being part of our journey!

AgeofGames
